data.title: Bitcoin Price Prediction After The $70,000 Short Squeeze
data.description: Bitcoin hit $70,000 for the first time since June 2 as billions in shorts were liquidated. The traders who called the squeeze now warn of a bull trap toward $44,000.
data.author: Boaz Sobrado
data.keywords: Bitcoin,bitcoin price prediction,bitcoin price forecast 2026,bitcoin short squeeze,bitcoin bull trap,bitcoin $70,000
